thread:
noah (engineering): Heads-up: prepping SDK v3.1 docs refresh + a small breaking change. We're renaming env var REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY. Also removing legacy sendEvents() in favor of client.streamEvents(). Will document migration steps.

lea (docs): please confirm exact deprecation schedule. Need dates for banners and changelog.

omar (product): plan: announce today, opt-in for 1 week, auto-migrate new installs after 1 week, full deprecate of sendEvents in 30 days with multiple warnings.

chris (support): are we auto-updating serverless starter templates? Customers on old deploys might fail.

noah (engineering): we'll add compatibility layer that reads REDWOOD_API_KEY for 4 weeks and logs a deprecation warning to telemetry. But older hosts that don't redeploy will still work until the 30-day cutoff.

lea (docs): snippet for migration page (Python):
```py
# old
import redwood
client = redwood.Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
# new
client = redwood.Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# streaming API (new)
for chunk in client.streamEvents(payload):
    handle(chunk)
```

kate (security): telemetry deprecation notices OK? we need to ensure no PII in warnings. We'll review log payloads.

omar (product): good call. security will sign off before we push console banners.

deploy-bot: deploy started: docs-site/v3.1-deprecations -> staging (build 6122). ETA 3m.

lea (docs): staging link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/v3.1-deprecations. Added FAQ and rollback steps.

chris (support): I'll draft canned responses and an internal KB article. Also tagging account owners with high usage.

noah (engineering): added CI job to run integration tests against both env var names and to validate streamEvents correctness. Will alert if any behavioral diffs.

omar (product): communication plan: in-console banner + email + release notes. Schedule: email immediate, banner during opt-in week, reminder emails at day 7 and day 21, final shutdown notice at day 30.

lea (docs): merging migration doc in 15m. Please review the FAQ section for edge cases (proxies, CI secrets).

kate (security): reviewed logging checklist, OK to proceed.

noah (engineering): one more: rename landed in SDK repo, npm/pypi packages will be cut as v3.1-beta. Tagging @release-team.

omar (product): thanks all. If anything blocks, post here. :loudspeaker:
